Package pl.rentathing.Rental.Controller

Class AdminRentalController

java.lang.Object
pl.rentathing.Rental.Controller.AdminRentalController
@Controller @RequestMapping("/admin/rentals") public class AdminRentalController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling operations related to rental management within the admin panel. Provides endpoints for viewing, creating, updating, and managing rentals. Also includes functionalities such as exporting rentals data to CSV and searching for users or items via APIs.

  • Method Details

    • listRentals

      @GetMapping public String listRentals(@RequestParam(required=false) String search, @RequestParam(required=false) RentalStatus status, @RequestParam(required=false) String category, @RequestParam(required=false) String returnDate, @PageableDefault(size=10,sort="createdAt",direction=DESC) org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Displays a paginated list of rentals in the admin panel. Provides filtering options based on search query, rental status, category, and return date. The list is sorted by creation date in descending order by default.
      Parameters:
      search - Optional search keyword to filter rentals by related data.
      status - Optional filter to specify the rental status.
      category - Optional filter to specify the category of the rental items.
      returnDate - Optional filter to specify rentals with a specific return date.
      pageable - Pagination information including page size, sort order, and page number.
      model - Spring's Model object to add attributes for rendering the view.
      Returns:
      A string representing the name of the view to render, which is "admin/rentals".
